historicalProposalEvidence.procedure: KEEP Action,60feet,concentration up to60seconds,HP60,AC17,2d10fire and aura burning adjacent foes. It has no second attack,casting,movement mode,light source,body-ignition or plane-origin power inferred from being fire. NEW the aura occupies actual within5feet of the body with body-to-recipient line of effect. At a creature's future regular START, if it is there and the conscious owner currently perceives/regards it as hostile, that creature makes DEX vs the original source owner's current spellDC: failure1d6fire, success half(floor). An already-underway START is not replayed; formation,entry,forced movement and extra turns cause no extra tick. This owner/target/Greater-Fire-Pet family can attempt at most one aura tick per numbered round, with the same history across replacement/copy bodies; outside initiative one per six-second cycle. Apply one shared aura roll for that owner's qualifying recipients in the cycle, retaining separate saves/defenses. Suppression or absence at the relevant checkpoint gives no stored attempt. This printed aura is an explicitly NEW passive exception to the companion offense limit: it can resolve independently of the one commanded attack, but neither grants another offensive Action nor commands other bodies. It is fire damage only, not a second generic Burning condition/tick, melted armor,ambient kiln,fuel or harvested elemental material. No target that the owner cannot actually perceive is secretly identified by the aura; it is not an allegiance detector. The pet's ordinary Action/command follows the shared attached phase; it can attack only through that real paid command. A successfully formed new Greater replaces its old same-source body, and genuine concentration commitment can already have ended an incompatible prior pet even if the new cast is countered. acceptedSourceRows.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP; concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds. Create one Greater Fire Pet in one perceived supported unoccupied footprint that fits its Medium body and has line of effect. Use AC5-PROFILE-GREATER-FIRE-PET-01 exactly: HP60, AC17, Speed30, commanded 5-ft Fire Strike for 2d10 fire using original owner's current spell attack, and the passive 5-ft aura.

The aura is not an entry trigger. At each perceived hostile recipient's future regular START while within 5 feet and body-to-recipient line of effect, make DEX vs original owner's current spell DC; failure takes 1d6 fire, success half floor. Max one aura attempt per owner/target/Greater-Fire-Pet family/numbered round, outside initiative once per six seconds. One d6 may be shared across the cycle but saves/defenses/damage roots are per recipient. The owner cannot use the aura as hidden allegiance detection: only creatures the conscious owner actually perceives/regards as hostile qualify.

Use shared Companion Command/global offense budget for Fire Strike; aura is the printed passive exception and does not grant another offensive Action. One Greater Fire Pet per owner, distinct from lower Fire Pet body cap but not from the owner-wide command/offense allowance.

Damage-root identity follows AC5-ROOT-01: commanded attack dealer=pet; each aura recipient root dealer=pet at that START. Owner Null Veil never automatically converts pet damage. Apply AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01/accepted Null lifecycle: qualifying Null damage to 0 keeps this same finite body Disabled 0 while concentration/source remains, including subsequent Null hits; legal Healing Rite/ordinary living-ally HP healing can restore above 0. Ordinary non-Null damage to 0 removes the body normally. Independent expiry/concentration/replacement still ends it.

Under Lesser Antimagic use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01. No fire immunity, extra light, fuel, generic Burning condition, corpse or harvestable elemental material is inferred.

historicalProposalEvidence.procedure: KEEP Action,one NEW warrior,60feet,concentration up to60seconds and FROM YOUR ALLIED FACTION. NEW resolve allied mechanically as one genuine canonical factionId with the caster's current standing above0at both commitment and resolution, using reviewed−3..+3 institutional records, plus no currently explicit faction ban on invoking its aid. This source-specific gate is not a general claim that all positive standing creates membership or magical access. Select that actual faction before payment. The spell creates one bounded summoned representative in that faction's known ordinary martial appearance, not a transported/copied named NPC or a promise that every real faction member consents to the caster's actions. It is a new temporary manifestation authorized by this spell's faction gate and carries no private faction memories,secret identity,rank,mandate to sign contracts or ability to issue institutional orders. It cannot impersonate a specific real unique official for an automatic credential benefit. NEW complete profile: Medium Humanoid-shaped magical companion (creature type Humanoid for actual targeting),baseHP70,AC18,walk30,bodyweight180lb,STR18,DEX12,CON16,INT10,WIS12,CHA12; six saves use original source owner's current PB total, other checks use printed ability modifiers without proficiencies. Ordinary sight/hearing, no darkvision,immunity,resistance,extra Reaction,spellcasting or trained trade. One commanded melee attack5feet using original owner's current spell-attack modifier,2d8+that owner's current PB slashing. A normal critical doubles only attack dice, not the PB flat. Its apparent martial armor,weapon and shield are intrinsic profile manifestations, not separate item grants,transferred faction stock or detachable loot. Use the shared owner BA command/attached phase/offensive allowance, with uncommanded defensive Move/Dodge; it knows its basic command channel but no generic spoken faction language or information-report ability. One Faction Champion per original owner across all factions, not one slot for each affiliation. A successful new creation replaces the prior body, while normal concentration commitment already ends an incompatible old spell. Hidden loss of faction eligibility prevents formation without reporting secret institutional facts; legal costs remain spent. Once formed, a later ordinary standing change does not create remote mind reading or immediate punitive attack; the admitted finite body persists until its real ending, with no new faction authority. Its creation/acts produce no automatic reputation gain,recruit roster seat,opening of Haven,free hireling or promised faction support outside this minute. Actual observed conduct/claims may still have real social consequences under EX58. It cannot undertake offscreen jobs,fill an expedition office,teach a formula or become an independent long-term character merely because its shape is a warrior. Genuine independently supplied objects have real inventory,load and custody; the intrinsic equipment is never copied out. At ending/suppression use the finite created-body procedure, preserving actualHPloss/sourceclock and real-item drops. No named person loses HP,inventory,injuries or availability at another location because no such person was transported. No cosmological source,plane,soul or faction divinity is inferred.

acceptedCaseAC5-X17.currentInitialState: Hostile summoned Champion C carries genuine lantern L and physically carries separate willing Small creature R. C source expires at t30. C fails CHA at t0; origin is under no Anchor initially. At t20 Dimensional Anchor is established over C's origin return endpoint.
actionsAndResolution: Before exile separate creature R is not gear; R remains origin-plane. C+legal noncreature lantern L transit into AC5-BANISH-EXT cell.
t20 Anchor begins over return endpoint; exile continues.
t30 Champion's independent summon source expires: body ends; intrinsic gear vanishes; genuine lantern remains loose. Elemental Banishment ends immediately because body source ended.
AC5-BANISH-EXT closes cell. Terminal Banishment blocker exception ignores only Anchor prevention for mandatory cargo return; L returns/settles once. C is not recreated and R never moved.
acceptedCaseAC5-X17.currentAdjudication: Source expiry outranks exile duration; real cargo preserved; separate creature never becomes gear.
acceptedCaseAC5-X17.evidenceKind: authored adjudication example; not runtime/human/balance test
